name: ORDER_BY_ASC_NULL_FIRST_DEFAULT
description: Default ORDER BY ASC places NULLs first

name: ORDER_BY_DESC_NULL_LAST_DEFAULT
description: Default ORDER BY DESC places NULLs last

name: ORDER_BY_ASC_NULLS_LAST_OVERRIDE
description: ASC NULLS LAST overrides default and sinks NULLs

name: ORDER_BY_DESC_NULLS_FIRST_OVERRIDE
description: DESC NULLS FIRST overrides default and floats NULLs

name: ORDER_BY_ASC_NULLS_FIRST_EXPLICIT
description: ASC NULLS FIRST matches default but is explicit

name: ORDER_BY_DESC_NULLS_LAST_EXPLICIT
description: DESC NULLS LAST matches default but is explicit

name: CREATE_INDEX_ASC_DEFAULT_OK
description: CREATE INDEX with plain ASC succeeds; query still orders NULLs first

name: CREATE_INDEX_DESC_DEFAULT_OK
description: CREATE INDEX with plain DESC succeeds; query orders NULLs last on DESC

name: CREATE_INDEX_ASC_NULLS_FIRST_REJECTED
description: sqlite3 3.45.1 rejects NULLS FIRST in CREATE INDEX (parse error)

name: CREATE_INDEX_DESC_NULLS_LAST_REJECTED
description: sqlite3 3.45.1 rejects DESC NULLS LAST in CREATE INDEX (parse error)

name: CREATE_INDEX_ASC_NULLS_LAST_REJECTED
description: CREATE INDEX with ASC NULLS LAST is also rejected in 3.45.1

name: CREATE_INDEX_DESC_NULLS_FIRST_REJECTED
description: CREATE INDEX with DESC NULLS FIRST is rejected in 3.45.1

name: ORDER_BY_COLLATE_NOCASE_ASC_DEFAULT
description: COLLATE NOCASE with ASC still places NULLs first, case-insensitive after

name: ORDER_BY_COLLATE_NOCASE_NULLS_LAST
description: COLLATE NOCASE combined with NULLS LAST sinks NULLs

name: DISTINCT_ORDER_BY_ASC_NULL_FIRST
description: DISTINCT collapses NULL duplicates; ORDER BY ASC still floats single NULL first

name: DISTINCT_ORDER_BY_DESC_NULLS_LAST
description: DISTINCT with DESC NULLS LAST: NULL collapses to one and sinks

name: MULTI_COL_ORDER_BY_MIXED_NULLS
description: Multi-column ORDER BY: a ASC then b DESC; defaults apply per column

name: UNION_ALL_ORDER_BY_ASC_NULL_FIRST
description: Compound UNION ALL with outer ORDER BY ASC: NULLs surface first
